about: Shared vectors for the integer forecast skill rule. A second implementation passes when it reproduces every 'expect' exactly. Every number is an integer.
rule: Arithmetic: every division is integer division truncating toward zero; isqrt is the floor square root.
Units: temperature in 0.01 degC, pressure in Pa (0.01 hPa); skill in millionths, 0..=1000000.
1 Range ('range'): temperature -10000..=10000, pressure 30000..=120000, inclusive. An out-of-range reading is ignored; an out-of-range forecast is unscored.
2 Times: commit = the commit block's time; target = commit + lead hours.

3 Readings that count ('rule3_scenarios'): a station reading counts when it is in range (rule 1), its provenance class is not 'synthetic' (no class recorded, or any other class, counts), and it has reached the oracle attestation quorum.

3a Quorum is taken AS OF the closing block: the first block whose time is >= target + 35 min. A reading that reaches quorum later does not count. A forecast is not scored before the chain tip's time has reached target + 35 min (15 minutes of readings plus 20 minutes to land and reach quorum), so the candidate set is closed. In 'rule3_scenarios', has_quorum is the state as of the closing block.
3b Truth candidates: landed in a block whose time is in [target - 15 min, target + 35 min). nearest_reading then requires |observed_at - target| <= 15 min.

3c Window candidates (for hourly_window and 'last'): landed at a height from the first block whose time is >= commit - 24 h up to commit_height - 1 (so: block_time >= commit - 24 h and height < commit_height). hourly_window and last_reading_before then require observed_at in [commit - 24 h, commit).
3d A reading that landed in any other block does not count, whatever observation time it claims (back-dated or future-dated).
4 Truth ('nearest_reading'): the candidate nearest target; ties go to the earlier reading, then the smaller id (byte order). None: no score.

5 Window ('hourly_window'): 24 slots, slot k = [commit - (24-k) h, commit - (23-k) h); sample = sum / count of the slot's readings, or null. 'last' ('last_reading_before') = the newest reading in [commit - 24 h, commit); ties: the smaller id.

6 Reference ('reference'), n = slots with a sample, lag = lead hours: fewer than 12 samples = no baseline (expect null, unscored). mean24 = sum/n. spread = isqrt((n*sum(x^2) - sum(x)^2) / n^2). pairs = slot pairs (i, i+lag) where both have a sample. persistence = isqrt(sum((x[i+lag]-x[i])^2) / pairs) when pairs >= 6, else null. reference = persistence when it is not null and smaller than spread ('persistence_spread'), else spread ('climatology_spread').

7 Score ('skill'): err = |forecast - truth|. copy = |forecast - mean24| <= tol or |forecast - last| <= tol (tol default 5). skill = 0 if copy or reference == 0, else max(0, 1000000 - 1000000*err/reference). beat_baseline = skill > 0.

Widths: with |x| <= 120000 (rule 1) and n <= 24: n*sum(x^2) <= 24*24*120000^2 < 8.3e12, sum(x)^2 < 8.3e12, sum of squared differences < 1.4e12, 1000000*err <= 2.4e11. Everything fits i64; no 128-bit arithmetic is needed. The separate 'skill_wide_arithmetic' section uses values near 2^31, outside the range rule, to check the arithmetic alone (1000000*err stays below 2^53); an implementation that range-checks inside its score function may skip that section. Every case in 'skill' names its variable and has forecast, truth, mean24 and last inside that variable's range.

'fixed_point' is NOT part of the rule: it is the backend's adapter from the decimal text the node relays today to fixed point (2 places, round half away from zero; null = refused). The rule itself takes integers.

rule3_scenarios.name: quorum: the nearest reading has no quorum, the next nearest is the truth
quorum: no candidate has quorum, no truth
provenance: synthetic never counts; no class recorded and other classes count
range: an out-of-range reading is skipped for the next nearest
truth landing blocks: [target - 15 min, target + 35 min)
truth: a reading landed in time but observed more than 15 minutes away is a candidate, not the truth
window landing height: commit - 1 counts, the commit block and later do not
window lower bound: landed at or after commit - 24 h
a full day: 24 hourly samples and a truth

skill.name: error one unit under the reference: smallest win
error above the reference: clamped to zero
copy of the 24 h mean, exactly
copy of the 24 h mean, at the tolerance
one past the tolerance of the mean: scored
copy of the last reading, at the tolerance below
one past the tolerance of the last reading: scored
zero reference: zero even when perfect
zero tolerance still catches an exact copy
zero tolerance, one unit off the last reading
forecast and truth on either side of zero
reference of one unit, error zero
reference of one unit, error one

skill_wide_arithmetic.name: values near 2^31, reference just above the error

reference.name: daily cycle, 1 h lead: persistence is the reference
daily cycle, 6 h lead: spread is the reference
daily cycle, 24 h lead: no pair, spread is the reference
12 samples spread out, no adjacent pair: spread
12 samples, 6 h lead: exactly 6 pairs, persistence considered
12 samples, 7 h lead: 5 pairs, persistence not used
18 h lead on a full window: exactly 6 pairs
19 h lead on a full window: 5 pairs, persistence not used
negative values: mean truncates toward zero
mixed signs: mean truncates toward zero
steady ramp: persistence equals the step

hourly_window.name: slot edges: the window start is in, the anchor is out
an hour boundary belongs to the later slot
slot mean truncates toward zero, both signs
several readings in one slot, missing hours stay empty

nearest_reading.name: one second past 15 minutes is out
same distance before and after: the earlier reading
same distance, listed the other way round: still the earlier reading
a reading exactly at the target
